home.heroTitle: All your medical needs in one place
home.heroBody: Find verified doctors, hospitals, centers, pharmacies and laboratories, see their services and how to reach them.
home.searchBody: Pick a type and governorate, or search by name.
home.servicesBody: The platform grows phase by phase. What is available works end to end; what is next is clearly marked.

services.providers: Discover verified doctors and medical facilities by type, specialty and governorate.
services.jobs: Medical jobs and a talent marketplace: structured applications and hiring inside Racheeta.
services.marketplace: A marketplace for medical equipment and supplies between companies and providers.
services.realEstate: Clinics and properties suited for medical use.

home.featuredBody: Real profiles verified by Racheeta administrators.
home.featuredEmptyBody: The first verified provider will appear here.

why.verifiedBody: No provider is public before Racheeta administrators review and verify the profile.
why.accountBody: One account for patients, providers and companies, with permissions decided by the server, never the app.
why.arabicBody: An interface designed for Arabic from day one, and ready for English.

home.ctaTitle: Are you a doctor or do you run a medical facility?
home.ctaBody: Create a provider account, complete your professional profile and request verification so patients can find you.
home.ctaOtherRole: Your current account is not a provider account. Provider accounts are created at registration; the account type cannot be changed by yourself.
home.jobsTitle: Jobs in the medical and health sector
home.jobsBody: Openings from verified hospitals, centres, pharmacies and laboratories. Professionals apply with a structured résumé and no files; organisations find talent and communicate inside Racheeta.
home.jobsHireHint: For verified medical organisations. Sign in or create an account, then register your organisation.
home.jobsSeekHint: Browse jobs freely and build your professional profile to apply.

providerProfile.onboardingIntro: Your account is a provider account. Create your professional profile; it becomes public once verified.
providerProfile.verificationHint: Your profile appears publicly after Racheeta administrators verify it.
providerProfile.typeLocked: The provider type cannot change after verification.

providerProfile.servicesIntro: The services you offer and their prices. Inactive services are not public.
providerProfile.counterpartHint: Copy the id from the other party's public profile link (/providers/…).

footer.tagline: Racheeta brings verified medical providers in Iraq together in one place, Arabic-first.

auth.sideTitle: A trusted medical platform, one account.
auth.sideBody: Log in to reach your account, or create a new one as a patient or provider.

talent.title: Talent search
talent.intro: Search professional profiles whose owners chose to be discoverable. No contact data is shown; invite them to apply or message them through their applications.
talent.searchNote: A search counts once per filter set per day; paging through results does not consume your quota.
talent.gate: Talent search requires a plan that includes this feature.
talent.savedNote: Private note (never shown to the candidate)

jobsPage.title: Medical and healthcare jobs
jobsPage.intro: Jobs published by verified healthcare organisations. Applying and communication happen inside Racheeta.
jobsPage.emptyBody: Try changing the filters or come back later.

jobDetail.salaryHidden: The employer has not published the salary.
jobDetail.coverHint: Do not include phone numbers or e-mail; communication happens inside Racheeta.
jobDetail.applied: Your application was sent. Track it under My applications.
jobDetail.createProfileToApply: Complete your résumé first to apply
jobDetail.closed: This job is not currently open for applications.
jobDetail.notFound: This job does not exist or is no longer available.
jobDetail.noContact: Direct contact details are not shared through Racheeta; communication happens through the application inside the platform.
jobDetail.employerCannotApply: Organisation accounts do not apply to jobs.

applications.title: My applications
applications.intro: The applications you sent and their current status.
applications.empty: You have not applied to any job yet.
applications.messagePlaceholder: Write a message (no phone numbers or e-mail)
applications.inviteAccepted: You accepted the invitation. You can apply from the job page.

seekerProfile.title: My résumé
seekerProfile.intro: Your structured résumé is what employers see. No file uploads needed.
seekerProfile.onboardingIntro: Fill in your core professional details. Experience and skills can be added afterwards.
seekerProfile.summaryHint: No contact information. Communication happens inside Racheeta.
seekerProfile.discoverable: Let employers find me in talent search
seekerProfile.discoverableHint: When off, you can still apply to jobs but will not appear in talent search. Employers never see your e-mail or phone.

employer.title: Employer workspace
employer.intro: Your organisation, plan, jobs and applicants in one place.
employer.onboardingIntro: Create the organisation account to start publishing jobs once Racheeta administrators verify it.
employer.descriptionHint: No contact information. Communication with candidates happens inside Racheeta.
employer.isAgency: Recruitment agency (lists on behalf of other organisations)
employer.linkProvider: Link to a medical facility profile (optional)
employer.verificationHint: Jobs cannot be published and talent cannot be searched until Racheeta administrators verify the organisation.
employer.recruitmentSuspended: Recruitment is suspended for this organisation by administrators.
employer.requestPlanIntro: Payment is currently handled manually outside the platform. After verifying payment, administrators activate the subscription. There is no online checkout.
employer.requestSent: Your request was sent. Administrators will activate the plan after verifying payment.
employer.pendingRequest: You have a subscription request awaiting administrator approval.
employer.noJobs: You have not created any job yet.
employer.identityLocked: Once verification is requested, the organisation's identity fields (name, type, governorate, linked facility, agency flag) are locked. Contact Racheeta administration to change them.
employer.pendingRequestPlan: Your request for the “{{plan}}” plan is waiting for Racheeta administration. There is no need to send another one.
employer.linkProviderHint: If you have a medical facility profile on Racheeta you can link it to this organisation before requesting verification. The link is locked once review starts.
employer.linkProviderNone: No medical facility profile is attached to your account.
employer.linkProviderNoneHint: Create a facility provider profile first if you want to link it to this organisation.

jobEditor.intro: Fill in the job details, then submit for administrator review. Do not put phone numbers or e-mail in the text.
jobEditor.sectionAgency: Recruiting on behalf of another organisation
jobEditor.title: Job title
jobEditor.flags: Contact information was detected in these fields:

jobEditor.retainedHiring: This draft still carries hiring-on-behalf-of details, but your organisation is no longer a recruitment agency. Saving clears those two fields so the job becomes editable and submittable again.

applicants.title: Applicants
applicants.intro: Applicants' professional profiles — no contact data. Communicate through messages inside Racheeta.

admin.title: Admin console
admin.intro: Verify organisations, review jobs, activate subscriptions and grant credits. Every action is written to the audit log.
admin.contactFindings: Possible contact details in the text
admin.subject: Subject
admin.creditsIntro: Grant extra credits to a specific billing account after an off-platform agreement. Credits are consumed once the plan limit is used up.
